sql_query: SELECT prescription_status, MAX(recommended_usage) AS max_recommended_usage FROM drug GROUP BY prescription_status;

SELECT institution_type, SUM(institution_country) AS sum_institution_country FROM institution WHERE parent_organization = 'University of Wisconsin' AND funding_sources != 'other' GROUP BY institution_type;

SELECT drug.prescription_status, SUM(disease.treatment_challenges) AS sum_disease_treatment_challenges FROM disease JOIN drug ON disease.disease_name = drug.disease_name WHERE disease.treatments != 'radiotherapy' OR drug.brand_name != 'Lo Loestrin FE' OR drug.brand_name = 'Nucala' GROUP BY drug.prescription_status;
